card.name: Needle pointing up, direction words
card.fires_on: The word 'up' or 'upward' right after 'needle pointing' or 'syringe held' in injection steps. Also direction-like words such as 'oblique' in imaging views, 'lines' in descent, and 'compass'.

modes.label: Syringe held up
modes.description: 'up' or 'upward' after the needle or syringe is said to point or be held.
modes.example: Holding the syringe with the needle pointing<< up>>, check the syringe for bubbles.

modes.label: Imaging view angle
modes.description: 'oblique' completing the phrase 'left anterior oblique' in cardiac imaging projections.
modes.example: It is recommended that images be made of the anterior, left anterior ob<<lique>> and left lateral projections.

modes.label: Other direction phrases
modes.description: Words that finish a phrase about direction or lineage in general text.
modes.example: It was a strongly matrilineal society with descent reckoned along female<< lines>>, and the leadership passed from the chief

card.writes: It pushes toward words like 'level' and 'levels' and away from 'direction' words, so it marks that the direction word is already given.
card.plain: It fires on the word that gives the direction, such as the needle pointing up when you remove air bubbles from a syringe.
